text: Approach. The thing does not back down.
Stand your ground.
Call out to them. Maybe something in there still listens.
Face the distortion. It will follow you regardless.
Hold perfectly still. Distortions sometimes pass.
Advance.
Announce yourself. It was trained to recognize ranks.
Confront what hunts you. That is the only way it ends.
Trace the letters. Try to read the name.
outcomeDescription: The letters resolve beneath your fingers slowly, as though the stone remembers being touched. A name surfaces within your mind — unfamiliar, yet painfully intimate. The moment you understand it, pain spreads behind your eyes and something buried shifts awake.
travelPassage: The grave marker disappears behind you, but the feeling does not. The name continues echoing somewhere beyond memory as the road ahead blurs into another fractured place.

text: Pass by without looking. Some distances are better kept.
Push the marker over. Some names should stay buried.
outcomeDescription: The stone collapses with more resistance than expected. Beneath it, someone hid a small pouch untouched by weather or time. For a brief moment, guilt settles heavier than the dust.
travelPassage: You leave the broken marker behind, but the silence around it lingers long after the path changes.

text: Take the left path. It looks older.
outcomeDescription: The older road winds through collapsing stone and half-swallowed ruins. Few footprints remain here. Whatever once travelled this way has long since vanished.
travelPassage: The path narrows gradually until the world around you feels quieter, older, and harder to place within memory.

text: Take the right path. Someone has been here recently.
outcomeDescription: Fresh tracks eventually disappear into the dust, but not before leading you toward a small abandoned satchel hidden beside the road.
travelPassage: Signs of recent movement fade behind you. Whoever passed through here is already gone by the time the landscape shifts again.

text: Sit at the crossroads. Let the exhaustion settle for a moment.
outcomeDescription: You sit beside the weathered signpost until your breathing steadies. The roads remain silent around you, untouched except by wind and memory.
travelPassage: When you rise again, the exhaustion has eased slightly. The crossroads fades slowly behind you as the next stretch of the journey unfolds.

text: Search the ruins carefully. Something was left here deliberately.
outcomeDescription: Hidden beneath collapsed stone, you uncover traces of an older conflict and fragments of memory tied to it. Something sharp presses against your thoughts as the vision settles in.
travelPassage: The ruins remain motionless behind you, but the memory uncovered there continues to bleed quietly into the road ahead.

text: Take what is visible without disturbing anything else.
outcomeDescription: You retrieve a preserved draught left within reach, untouched by decay. The rest of the ruins remain undisturbed.
travelPassage: The abandoned structure fades behind you, carrying with it the uneasy sense that someone once intended to return.

text: Leave it undisturbed. Ruins remember being touched.
outcomeDescription: You resist the urge to search deeper. Some places feel less abandoned than they appear.
travelPassage: The ruins watch silently as you continue onward, swallowed gradually by distance and haze.

text: Listen carefully to what they have to say.
outcomeDescription: Their warning begins cautiously, but certain phrases strike something buried within you. Pieces of forgotten understanding resurface before the conversation ends.
travelPassage: The stranger's words remain with you long after their voice disappears behind the shifting road.

text: Share your own experience in return.
outcomeDescription: For a brief moment, the conversation feels painfully human. Speaking aloud eases part of the weight you have been carrying.
travelPassage: You leave behind the warmth of shared understanding and continue into quieter territory once more.

text: Thank them and continue walking.
outcomeDescription: The stranger offers a final nod before disappearing back into the road behind you. Near where they stood, you notice a few forgotten coins.
travelPassage: Their warning follows you further than expected, repeating quietly within your thoughts as the world changes again.

text: Hold the memory. Try to feel it fully.
outcomeDescription: Heat and smoke surge through the memory with unbearable clarity. You force yourself not to look away, even as grief tears through you.
travelPassage: The smell of ash lingers long after the vision fades, carried with you into the next fragment of the journey.

text: Let it pass through you without catching.
outcomeDescription: The memory brushes against you like heat from a distant fire before dissolving back into silence.
travelPassage: You continue onward without fully understanding what you almost remembered.

text: Reach into the memory. There is something important here.
outcomeDescription: The chamber floods your senses with impossible detail — machinery, voices, desperation. Something vital reveals itself before the strain becomes unbearable.
travelPassage: The vision fractures apart around you, but fragments of it continue pulsing beneath your thoughts as you move forward.

text: Pull back before it takes too much from you.
outcomeDescription: You sever the connection before the memory fully consumes you, though part of its meaning still follows you back.
travelPassage: The chamber fades behind your perception, leaving only scattered impressions and unanswered questions.

text: Reject the memory entirely. You cannot afford it right now.
outcomeDescription: You force the memory away before it fully forms. The resistance leaves a dull ache behind your eyes.
travelPassage: Though the vision never fully surfaced, you cannot escape the feeling that something important was left unfinished.

text: Let the light take you where it wants to go.
outcomeDescription: The light engulfs everything — sound, memory, identity. Within it, you glimpse a catastrophe too large for language before the pain forces you back.
travelPassage: Even after the brilliance fades, faint fractures of light continue drifting at the edge of your vision.

text: Shield yourself. Do not let it reach the center of things.
outcomeDescription: You turn away from the worst of the radiance, though even indirect exposure leaves your senses ringing painfully.
travelPassage: The unnatural glow fades slowly behind you, swallowed at last by distance and shadow.

text: Run from it. Some things do not need to be understood.
outcomeDescription: You flee before the light can fully reach you. Even without understanding it, instinct tells you the decision was necessary.
travelPassage: The brightness recedes behind you, though the fear it inspired remains difficult to shake.

text: Take what is here. Someone left it for a reason.
outcomeDescription: The cache contains preserved supplies and scattered coin sealed carefully against time and moisture. Whoever hid them never returned.
travelPassage: You leave the hidden cache behind and continue onward carrying the uneasy feeling of inheriting another traveler's unfinished journey.

text: Leave it. You do not know what touched it last.
Open the cache carefully.
Leave it for whoever needs it more.
Rest until the weight lifts.
Speak with a resident who seems to recognize something in you.
Browse what is for sale at the edge of the square.
Leave the settlement.
Take shelter here briefly.
Search through the old records left behind.
Continue without stopping.
Walk into the distortion. It has something to show you.
Force yourself through as quickly as possible.
Wait at the edge. Some distortions resolve on their own.
Buy a healer's draught.
Buy a scroll of clarity.
Look at what is available without committing.
Step forward. There is no other way through this.
